e: Citing the group's treatment of women, the ICC unseals arrest warrants for Taliban leaders Hibatullah Akhundzada, Abdul Hakim Haqqani, Habibullah Agha, and Neda Mohammad Nadeem.
Pakistan launches air strikes on what is described as "terrorist camps" in Afghanistan.
Pakistan finds eight drones launched from Afghanistan and launches air strikes, killing four people.
Pakistan launches air strikes against Afghanistan in retaliation for the 2026 Kohat attack, killing a family of three and injuring four others.
A magnitude 4.9 earthquake hits Nangarhar Province, injuring 15 people.
Floods kill at least 20 people in Nuristan Province.
Pakistan launches airstrikes in Kunar, Paktia, and Paktika in retaliation for an attack in Karachi on 27 June claimed by Jamaat-ul-Ahrar.

A protest takes place in Herat against the detention of women who violate strict dress codes mandated by the Ministry for the Propagation of Virtue and the Prevention of Vice. Taliban police react by firing live rounds into the protest, reportedly killing at least two demonstrators.
A truck carrying returning refugees from Pakistan overturns in Laghman Province, killing 22 people and injuring 36 others.
Russia signs a military partnership agreement with the Taliban.
Torrential rain and heavy floods kill 11 and injure 15 others in the provinces of Panjshir, Paktia, Baghlan, and Takhar
The Taliban announce the detention of two journalists from TOLONews on unspecified charges.
Three people are killed in suspected Pakistani attacks in Kunar Province.
On World Press Freedom Day, journalists launch the Kabul Times News media outlet in exile in France amidst media restrictions in Afghanistan.
Seven people are killed in suspected Pakistani attacks on Asadabad, Kunar Province.
Eleven people are killed in a gun attack on a recreational area in Injil District, Herat Province.
The Taliban says that it has captured a border post during clashes in Khost.
One child is killed and three others are injured after a piece of unexploded ordnance detonates in Khost Province.
A magnitude 5.8 earthquake hits the Hindu Kush, killing eight people in a house collapse in Kabul.
Two people are killed, including a child, and at least 90 families are affected in flooding in Kandahar.
Two people are killed by Pakistani shelling in Khost Province.
At least 100 people are killed in a suspected Pakistani airstrike on a drug rehabilitation clinic in Kabul.
Six people are killed and several others injured in a Pakistani airstrike against a residential area in Kabul. A fuel depot in Kandahar is also bombed.
Four people are killed by Pakistani shelling in Sadqo, Khost Province.
The United States designates Afghanistan as a sponsor of wrongful detention.

The United Nations High Commissioner for Refugees reports at least 100,000 civilians have been displaced from their homes due to the fighting between Afghanistan and Pakistan, while Afghan forces say they have destroyed 14 more Pakistani military outposts along the border and downed a drone.
The United Kingdom suspends the issuance of work and student visas to Afghan nationals as part of efforts to reduce asylum requests.
Pakistan says 67 Afghans and one Pakistani soldier had been killed in clashes along their border.

The Taliban says the Afghan military has successfully repelled Pakistani warplanes with surface-to-air missiles that were attacking Bagram Airfield as explosions are reported in several cities, including Kabul.
Anti-aircraft fire is reported over Kabul, as Pakistani warplanes launch strikes against Taliban targets.
Pakistan declares "open war" against the Afghan Taliban.

The Afghan Taliban carry out attacks on Pakistani army posts. The Taliban says about 40 Pakistani soldiers were killed, while Pakistani security sources claim 22 Taliban personnel dead and several quadcopters shot down.
Pakistan carries out airstrikes on suspected militant camps in Nangarhar and Paktika provinces, killing 18 people.
Three Pakistani soldiers captured by Afghanistan during the 2025 Afghanistan–Pakistan conflict are released following mediation by Saudi Arabia.
A magnitude 4.5 earthquake hits Balkh province, injuring three people.
A minibus falls into a valley in Badakhshan province, killing 15 people.
Seven people are killed in a house collapse in Jalalabad.
At least 61 people are reported killed in three days of nationwide snowstorms.
Six people are killed in rainstorms in Kandahar.
Seven people are killed in a bomb attack at a restaurant in Shahr-e Naw, Kabul. Islamic State claims responsibility.
